paper_title: Supernova axions convert to gamma-rays in magnetic fields of progenitor stars
coupling_convention: g_agammagamma in GeV^-1, exactly as plotted on the y-axis of Fig. 1
notes: Paper presents a NEW 95% CL exclusion on g_agamma from non-observation of SMM gamma-rays coincident with SN1987A, extended to higher masses (up to ~1e-2 eV) via axion-photon conversion in the progenitor star's magnetic field (conservative 100 G surface field). Explicit numbers in text: low-mass limit |g_agamma| < 2.6e-12 GeV^-1 (full analysis, UF Galactic B-field model); 3.1e-12 with Primakoff only; validity up to |g_agamma| ~ 1e-8 GeV^-1 at ma ~ 1e-2 eV. No table provided; intermediate/high-mass points are approximate reconstructions from Fig. 1 description (stellar conversion dominates above ~1e-9 eV, degrades above ~5e-5 eV, new parameter space excluded for ma > 10 ueV), hence moderate extraction confidence. Points correspond to the 'ALP SN1987A' curve (loop-induced hadronic couplings). Paper also contains projections (GALAXIS, next Galactic SN, NS mergers), but main result is the measured SN1987A limit. Astrophysical bound: no DM density assumption. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.7, 42)) | Vision: Boundary is the lower edge of the blue 'ALP SN1987A (excl. 95%)' region in Fig. 1 (B0 = 100 G progenitor surface field, conservative). Anchored to explicit text values: flat at 2.6e-12 GeV^-1 for m_a < ~2e-11 eV (Galactic conversion); transition region 2e-11 to 1e-9 eV where Galactic conversion degrades; stellar-field conversion dominates for m_a > 1e-9 eV giving a plateau at ~3e-11 GeV^-1 read from the plot; degradation above ~5e-5 eV with limit rising roughly proportional to m_a, reaching g ~ 1e-8 GeV^-1 at m_a ~ 1e-2 eV where the analysis validity ends (axion luminosity vs neutrino luminosity). Fine oscillatory wiggles in the transition regions are smoothed. The KSVZ-like hatched limit (assuming KSVZ hadronic coupling ratios) is a separate, similar curve not traced here.
